newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Turnover down on Romania OTC market.
newsitem.headline: Turnover down on Romania OTC market.

text.p: Turnover on Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market fell to around 16.0 billion lei this week from last week's 18.1 billion lei level.
Traders said supply was thin with investors waiting for listings to announce last year's financial data. Most prices rose with low supply and expectations for higher dividends.
High-cap cement maker Romcim SA remained the favourite target for investors, closing 2,300 lei stronger at 36,300 lei.
Over 10.4 million shares were traded over the week on the RASDAQ -- the Romanian OTC system modelled on the U.S. NASDAQ -- down from 11.1 million the previous week.
The independent VAB-RASDAQ index, computed by Vanguard SA securities, rose 151.3 points on the week to 1,791.4.
The RASDAQ, which opened last October to eventually trade 5,000 companies privatised under a mass selloff, now lists 2,705 stocks. It traded an average 348 companies this week.
